description: Searchable command palette overlay (Cmd+K style) with filterable actions, descriptions, keyboard shortcut hints and item icons. Supports two-way binding on open state; the backdrop dismisses on a click whose press started on it (a drag-select from the input that ends over the backdrop keeps it open). Local Actions filter synchronously (title, description, code); an optional asynchronous SearchProvider extends the list with remote results (local first), with debounce, cancellation of superseded requests, loading skeleton, empty and transient-error-with-retry states and a polite result-count announcement. GroupByCategory adds a heading per category and a divider (CSS border) between groups; SplitShortcuts renders one kbd per key; ShowIcons (default true) renders the action icon with an empty placeholder slot for actions without one; the trailing slot shows a Badge + Code by default; ShowFooter renders the keyboard-hint footer. All new capabilities except ShowIcons are opt-in.

parameters.name: IsOpen
parameters.description: Whether the command palette is visible.

parameters.name: IsOpenChanged
parameters.description: Fires when IsOpen should change (two-way binding).

parameters.name: GroupByCategory
parameters.description: Groups actions by Category: a heading per category and a divider (CSS border) between groups. A null/empty category renders its options without a group wrapper (a role=group must be named). Defaults to false.

parameters.name: SplitShortcuts
parameters.description: Renders each '+'-separated part of a shortcut as its own kbd. Defaults to false.

parameters.name: ShowIcons
parameters.description: Renders ICommandPaletteAction.Icon through TmIcon at the leading edge of each item; an item without an icon gets an empty slot of the same width so titles line up. Defaults to true (since 2.11.0 — a visual breaking change; see the CHANGELOG Breaking/Migration section).

parameters.name: SearchProvider
parameters.description: Asynchronous search source: invoked with the debounced query and a cancellation token that is cancelled when the query changes, the palette closes or the component disposes. Results are appended after the local Actions matches. Null (the default) keeps the palette purely local.

parameters.name: DebounceMs
parameters.description: Debounce delay in milliseconds from the last keystroke before the provider runs. 0 calls it immediately. Defaults to 300.

parameters.name: MinChars
parameters.description: Minimum query length that triggers SearchProvider. 0 calls the provider even for the empty query (e.g. 'recent items'). Defaults to 1.

parameters.name: IsLoading
parameters.description: Host-driven loading state (for hosts that fill Actions themselves); ORs with the internal provider state.

parameters.name: LoadingTemplate
parameters.description: Overrides the default loading rows (three TmSkeleton bars) shown while a search runs.

parameters.name: EmptyTemplate
parameters.description: Overrides the empty state; receives the current query.

parameters.name: TransientErrorTemplate
parameters.description: Overrides the inline transient-error state; receives the retry callback.

parameters.name: ItemTrailingTemplate
parameters.description: Overrides the trailing slot of each item (badge + code by default).

parameters.name: ItemTemplate
parameters.description: Overrides the whole content of each item; the option wrapper (role=option, id, aria-selected, click) stays the component's.

parameters.name: HighlightMatches
parameters.description: Marks the query in the title and the code via TmHighlightedText. Defaults to false.

parameters.name: ShowFooter
parameters.description: Renders the keyboard-hint footer (up/down navigate, enter select, esc close). Defaults to false.

parameters.name: FooterTemplate
parameters.description: Overrides the footer content; renders even without ShowFooter.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class for the root element.
